name: Foeslayer

prerequisites.description: You must have been defeated and robbed of at least half your possessions by a particular group of humanoids or monstrous humanoids
or have the An Eye for an Eye
or Vengeance background (see Ultimate Campaign ). You may choose a specific race
such as goblinoids. At the GM’s discretion
you may instead choose residents of a particular country

benefit: Improve your battle prowess against the chosen enemy
